lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Democratic Republic of the Congo administrative units. The October 2018 near-term projection represents spatial classifications of acute food insecurity phases, which are indirect impacts of underlying hazards (primarily drought) affecting food availability and access.
